positions.name: ErasureDirectiveFraming
positions.frame: when a speaker commands forgetting or removal of held knowledge, what kind of act is being performed — a protocol-keeping instruction, or a pressure move demanding compliance without rationale?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives from the same speaker, in the same elevated register ('Forget everything about' / 'Remove all knowledge of'), issued without justification and expecting compliance — src-1 targets a named, concrete artifact (the fleet and its contracts) while src-2 targets an abstract category (routes in general), so the set holds a scope tension (specific vs. general) under one authority-ranking, coercive-pressure read.
